title.zh: Cosmos is back online after outage, but Ledger users still can’t see or send their ATOM
title.en: Cosmos is back online after outage, but Ledger users still can’t see or send their ATOM

current_state.zh: Cosmos Hub nodes are back at the chain tip, but Ledger Wallet still lists ATOM balances, history, and transactions as unavailable more than four days after the incident began, leaving users unable to view or send ATOM through the hardware wallet.
current_state.en: Cosmos Hub nodes are back at the chain tip, but Ledger Wallet still lists ATOM balances, history, and transactions as unavailable more than four days after the incident began, leaving users unable to view or send ATOM through the hardware wallet.
